newsitem.title: USA: Computer Horizons gets Lockheed contract.
newsitem.headline: Computer Horizons gets Lockheed contract.

text.p: Computer Horizons Corp said Wednesday it had won a "multi-million dollar" contract from Lockheed Martin Corp to reprogram its computer systems so as to avoid a crash at the turn of the next century.
The company said it would provide its Year 2000 services to Lockheed Martin, which will prevent computers from crashing when their software fails to distinguish between the year 1900 and 2000.
Based in Bethesda, Maryland, Lockheed Martin makes technological products for businesses that span aeronautics, electronics, energy and environment, among others.
